about: Items Fable has reviewed and rewritten, by key, with the pass that did it. tools/review-ledger.mjs reads this file. Example entry: "module:saving-investing-and-risk": "JF". "reviewed" means the full standard in docs/FABLE-REVIEW.md; "firstPass" means accuracy, punctuation and audio tags only (passes JG to JN), still due the full read.

reviewed.module:rhymes: JV, full standard: shows a pair that does not rhyme (cat and dog), which half its questions ask; the example showed dog and log captioned cat and hat; every explanation names the shared ending (both end with at); never asks Up ends with up; a bat flies into the story's rhyme
reviewed.module:tracing-letters: JV, full standard: traces every letter it asks (L, T, I, H, E, F, O and C; it showed only L and asked seventeen); slants and zigzags moved to the lessons that trace them; T in the story goes across first, as the app draws it
reviewed.module:tracing-small-letters: JV, full standard: traces all nine small letters it asks (it showed l and o); most small letters sit low and a few reach up tall (it said all sit low, while asking for l and t)
reviewed.module:tracing-more-letters: JV, full standard: traces every letter it asks (Z, W, M, X, Y and K; it showed Z and K and asked fifteen); the story builds K and X, its own letters
reviewed.module:syllables: JV, full standard: syllables named; the chin trick; comparing claps taught, since its questions compare; explanations in whole sentences (Monkey has two claps, mon and key); Say the word monkey slowly, not Say it slowly, monkey
reviewed.module:sounding-out: JV, full standard: sounds written for a voice (cuh, the sound at the start of apple, tuh), never bare letters a voice reads as names; the five short vowels taught with anchor words; questions ask which letter makes a sound; TEKS K.2.B.ii and K.2.A.viii; the story blends sounds, not letter names
reviewed.module:which-way-we-read: JV, full standard: words, not letters, left to right; spaces between words, since a question counts them; return sweep; backward means the words in reverse order (the story said tac and gid); TEKS K.2.D.ii and K.2.D.iii quoted
reviewed.module:word-meanings: JV, full standard: names every shape, solid and number word its questions use (it named two); the example showed a triangle captioned circle; explanations give the reason a picture fits; TEKS K.3.B and K.3.C
reviewed.module:trace-slant-letters: JV, full standard: A is two slants down from its point (it said slant up); N starts at the top (it was drawn from the bottom); explanations describe the strokes
